subject: CLAIM lowering-opus B2 (per root decision): compute_frontend.m executor regions: shadow-sync wait (~1843-1847), mid-command reap block (~1879-1885) + TEGU_PERF_ASYNC counters (decl ~62, line ~1561); compositor_submit.inc: one new helper after tegu_shadow_jobs_any; bridge n2mb_wait_handles (mine)
body: B2 design: the bridge keeps the handles of this context's 64 newest kernel jobs (kernel holds <=32 in flight) and n2mb_wait_handles(handles) WAIT_SEQs only up to the newest unreaped job listing one of them (flushes an open chain holding one). Frontend: shadow refresh waits only for the shadows' backing handles that will really be refreshed (seed changed); mid-command CPU work waits only for its own buffers (blit: buffers[0..1]; re-expansion: index/source/out; preclear: buffers[1]); events keep the full reap. mid_reaps split by cause in TEGU_PERF_ASYNC. Pipeline/variant/plan code untouched.
